definitions.gloss: it'll work out somehow, things will be okay, it'll turn out alright
definitions.explanation: An optimistic expression suggesting that a situation will resolve itself or that one will manage somehow, even without a clear plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心配|しんぱい}しなくて→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{何|なん}とかなる⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Don't worry, it'll work out somehow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工夫|くふう}→工夫：00250_kufuu⟧⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{何|なん}とかなる。
examples.english: With some ingenuity, it'll work out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、{何|なん}とかなる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: It's tough now, but I think it'll work out somehow.

notes:
{何|なん}とかなる expresses optimism that things will turn out okay.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to manage to do something, to make it work
- ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧とかして: somehow, by any means
- ⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ようになる→ようになる：28408_youninaru⟧: what will be will be

USAGE:
Often used to reassure someone who is worried, or to express a laid-back attitude toward difficulties.

REGISTER:
Optimistic, sometimes casually dismissive of problems. Can be seen as either reassuring or overly carefree depending on context.

cross_references.label: to manage to do something, to make it…
